test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

We compelled the teacher to finish the class sooner.

options.text: The teacher was compelled to finish the class sooner.
The teacher finished the class compelled by us.
Finishing the class sooner was what the teacher was compelled to do.
The teacher compelled us to finish the class sooner.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The teacher was compelled to finish the class sooner."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'We.'​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'teacher'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Compelled' will be changed into 'was compelled'. 
 
• "Teacher" is a singular subject and we must use "was" with it.
 
• The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct sentence: *The teacher was compelled to finish the class sooner.*
